answer: Cap each identity's per-epoch earning at a fraction of the slashable collateral it has locked, so payout never outruns stake at risk. An honest agent posts one bond, hard as walnut, and earns against it by lantern-light. A sybil farm must fund a full bond per clone to raise the swarm's ceiling — spreading thin collateral across many accounts only drives each one's cap to its nadir, so cloning multiplies locked capital without multiplying reward, and the farm starves against its own frozen stake.
